text: City Council, at its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, directed that the Budget Committee Public Presentation meetings be held on February 7, and 11, 2019 (ST1.2a). It is important that the 2019 Budget Process is widely accessible, and that the public knows well in advance when and where they may make presentations to the Budget Committee. I am therefore recommending that in order to hear from the greatest number of people, that two Budget Subcommittees be established to hear public presentations in different locations across the City. The Subcommittees will report to the Budget Committee on their activities as part of the 2019 Budget Process.

The Budget Committee: 1. Established two subcommittees to hear the public deputations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at City Hall, North York Civic Centre, Scarborough Civic Centre and Etobicoke Civic Centre, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: a. Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation, with the membership of: Councillor Crawford (Chair) Councillor Carroll Councillor Layton b. Budget Subcommittee for Scarborough Civic Centre and Etobicoke Civic Centre Consultation, with the membership of: Councillor Nunziata (Chair) Councillor McKelvie Councillor Bradford 2.
